name: scribe-animator-director
description: Author editable Scribe Animator scenes with live Site tools or validated AI JSON. Requires separate browser and visual acceptance.

interface.longDescription: Create and revise editable whiteboard animations and explainer scenes in Scribe Animator using discovered live Site tools or self-contained AI JSON validated with the bundled offline validator. Work with native editable objects, Draw Steps, object animation and camera timing. Preview, edit and export results inside Scribe through its supported video or .scribe project options. Live authoring and visual QA require separate access to a supported browser session with Site tools available. Playback and export must be checked separately.
defaultPrompt: Use Scribe Animator Director to create an editable explainer scene.
